name: claude-model-provider
description: Provides Claude language models via the Anthropic API

commands.title: Claude Model Provider: Update API Key

claude-model-provider.promptCaching.markdownDescription: Cache the request prefix for 5min using Anthropic API's [prompt caching](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/prompt-caching). Later turns in a conversation re-read the cached prefix at reduced cost. If you are mainly sending single requests, rather than multi-turn conversations, you may want to turn this off.

enumDescriptions: Use the model's default. Newer models (e.g. Opus 5 and later, Sonnet 5 and later) think by default, older ones (e.g. Opus 4.8) don't.
Enable adaptive thinking on all models that support it: Claude decides when and how much to think.
claude-model-provider.thinking.markdownDescription: Controls [extended thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/extended-thinking). Thinking improves results on complex tasks, but increases cost and latency. Thinking tokens are billed as output tokens. Not applied when a caller forces tool use. Can be overridden per request by passing `thinking` in `modelOptions`.

enumDescriptions: Use the model's default effort level.
Fastest and cheapest. Good for simple tasks.
Thorough. Recommended minimum for complex tasks.
Recommended for most coding and agentic tasks on newer models.
Highest quality, at the highest cost.
claude-model-provider.effort.markdownDescription: How much effort Claude spends on a response, including how deeply it thinks. Higher effort generally gives better results but uses more tokens. Ignored for models that don't support effort; levels a model doesn't support fall back to the closest lower one. Can be overridden per request by passing `effort` in `modelOptions`.
